name: Tainrakuasuchus
sum: Tainrakuasuchus is a poposauroid pseudosuchian, a quadrupedal active predator, from the Middle Triassic of southern Brazil.
wsnote: About 2.4 m long and 60 kg, based on the holotype (English Wikipedia).
holotype: CAPPA/UFSM 0506: part of the left lower jaw (dentary, splenial, four partial teeth), two cervical vertebrae, three dorsal vertebrae and the right ilium.
biology: Likely a quadrupedal active predator with a long neck, slender jaws and recurved sharp teeth (English Wikipedia).
author: Müller et al. 2025

sources.text: Müller, R. T., Garcia, M. S., Damke, L. V. S., Prestes de Bem, F., Fonseca, A. de O., Doering, M., Schiefelbein, J. H. and Laste, V. Z. D. 2025. Osteology, taxonomy and phylogenetic affinities of a new pseudosuchian archosaur from the Middle Triassic of southern Brazil. Journal of Systematic Palaeontology 23(1): 2573750.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Middle Triassic (English Wikipedia, no stage given); the ICS Anisian-Ladinian range is used.
